# unifi_network_port_forward (Resource)

A UniFi port-forwarding rule (`portforward`, legacy `/rest`) — destination-NAT from a WAN port to an internal host.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination_port` (String) External port or range to forward (e.g. `443` or `8000-8010`).
- `forward_ip` (String) Internal host IP to forward to.
- `name` (String) Rule name.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is active. Defaults to `true`.
- `forward_port` (String) Internal port or range. Defaults to `destination_port` when omitted.
- `interface` (String) WAN the rule listens on: `wan`, `wan2`, or `both`. Defaults to `wan`.
- `log` (Boolean) Log matches in the firewall log. Defaults to `false`.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol: `tcp_udp`, `tcp`, or `udp`. Defaults to `tcp_udp`.
- `source` (String) Source filter: `any` (default) or a restricting IP/CIDR.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Controller object ID (`_id`). Import key.
